frame_image_note: Video co hieu ung quet sang (light-wipe) o dau: frame 0-8 san pham dung tren nen beige tron (chua co hieu ung), vach sang quet tu trai sang phai trong khoang frame 9-20, quet het va lo ra day du mat nuoc vang long lanh o ~frame 21-22/129 (24fps). effect_prompt: A pool of molten liquid gold ripples gently beneath and around the product, with soft concentric ripples slowly spreading and shifting across the glossy surface. Warm diagonal streaks of bright light slowly sweep across the liquid gold background, creating shifting highlights and reflections over time. A glossy mirror-like reflection of the product shimmers on the rippling golden surface below. The camera stays completely fixed throughout, with no camera movement, no pan, no zoom; warm golden studio lighting, photorealistic advertisement cinematography, consistent composition.
effect_prompt_note: So sanh cac frame 22/30/45/60/75/90/105/120/128: khung hinh, vi tri san pham va duong chan deu khong doi -> camera co dinh, khong pan/zoom/xoay. Hieu ung nen la mat chat long vang gon song lien tuc + vung sang cheo quet/dich chuyen qua lai tren be mat (giong anh sang phan chieu di dong), cuong do khong tang dan ro ret ma chi bien doi tuan hoan -- khac voi smoky-pedestal (khoi day dan). Khong phat hien chuyen dong camera nao, chi co chuyen dong cua chat long/anh sang.

image_prompt_note: Viet lai 2026-10 LAN 3 theo cau truc NGUOI DUNG tu phat hien tren dome-product (giay->lon): KHONG dung cau lenh 'Replace' (lan 2, ngan gon, chi hieu qua khi hinh dang vat cu/moi gan giong nhau), ma mo ta TRUC TIEP canh cuoi cung nhu dang ke lai 1 buc anh co san ('X holds the single product from image 2, [tu the cu the]...'). Vat the CU chi duoc nhac 1 LAN DUY NHAT, ngan gon, lam moc vi tri/kich thuoc ('in the spot where the X was', 'about the same size as the X') -- KHONG mo ta hinh dang/chat lieu cua no. Phan lon do dai danh cho: (a) mo ta quan he VAT LY cu the cua san pham moi (dung o dau, de len gi, bong do the nao), (b) mo ta TUONG TAC QUANG HOC giua san pham moi va canh (anh sang/phan chieu/khoi/nuoc cham vao be mat san pham) de model 'tich hop' thay vi 'dan de'. Da test thuc nghiem tren dome-product (giay->lon, ca KHO nhat voi cong thuc Replace don gian): THANH CONG ro ret, lon thay giay hoan toan sach se trong 1 lan chay.
